summary: Remove unwanted padding from the edges.
documentation: strip creates a string with leading and trailing whitespace removed. With chars, it removes any of those characters from each end.
inputs: A string and an optional set of characters to remove.
caution: The chars argument is a set of characters, not a prefix or suffix. Interior whitespace remains unchanged.
scenarios: Clean names pasted into a CRM.
Normalize labels read from text files.
Remove accidental padding from form values.
title: Clean the customer name
problem: Return the input string with leading and trailing whitespace removed. Preserve all internal whitespace and letter case.
goal: Use str.strip() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
